implementation_impact: No SDK install/version selection, provider call, retries or finality added. Preserve owner-supplied identity and typed evidence only.

sources.finding: Stripe compares parameters for reused idempotency keys and persists initial execution results; retention and key constraints are provider-specific, not generic Tunner policy.
Network and server errors can leave an indeterminate external outcome. No transport exception is normalized to proof of no effect.
Existing .NET 10 OpenAPI 3.1 build-time generation remains supported.
OpenAPI 3.1 remains the selected published baseline.
